moments.author: Jake Schneider
moments.quote: Using only mind power to drive the wheelchair with my Neuralink N1 implant.
moments.why: A striking demonstration of brain‑computer interface giving ALS patients unprecedented autonomy has gone viral.

moments.author: Jake Paul
moments.quote: The game’s not over. Christmas Eve in Dubai. Checkmate.
moments.why: Men 25‑45 are buzzing over his high‑stakes comeback: a Dec. 24 boxing return where he vows to retire if he loses.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Making an app where you upload your bills and bored billionaires swipe right to pay them.
moments.why: Though he didn’t actually post it, the viral ‘Billionaire Tinder’ joke attributed to Musk is sparking real app ideas and furious online chatter.
